title: Lola Young Announces 2027 Everything Begins Tour
excerpt: Lola Young has announced the Everything Begins Tour, a 17-date North American headline run set for spring 2027.
body:
Lola Young has announced the Everything Begins Tour, a 17-date North American headline run set for spring 2027. It will be her first full tour of the region since she stepped away from touring in 2025, moving her return from individual appearances into a dedicated headline schedule.

The title Everything Begins flips one of Young's own tattoos. She has "Everything Ends" tattooed on her body, and the tour name reverses that phrase around the idea of starting again. It gives the announcement a connection to the period she has been writing about in her recent music rather than functioning as a label placed on a list of dates.

Young returned with "From Down Here" after stepping away from touring. She wrote the song with James Blake, and it arrived after "Messy" won a Grammy. The song marked her return to recording and introduced a more hopeful tone, though its lyrics still sit with the uncertainty of coming back. Since then, she has moved into regular live work through festivals and UK shows. Rather than announcing a long route immediately, she returned in stages, first with individual performances and new music and now with a run built around her own headline show. That pace makes the tour announcement feel earned rather than abrupt.

[youtube:YFhpMpONGUY]

Everything Begins turns that gradual return into a full headline plan. The route includes Radio City Music Hall and the Greek Theatre, plus two nights in Toronto. Those bookings show the change in scale without requiring a city-by-city list, while the same support act is scheduled across the announced run instead of changing from stop to stop.

Artist presales begin October 7, followed by the general sale on October 9 at 10 a.m. local time through Young's official site. Sofia and the Antoinettes will support the announced dates. The tour gives Young a continuous headline run at a point when her live career is moving into larger rooms, while the new single provides the clearest indication of what she will be bringing to those stages beyond the songs that first expanded her audience.
